Re: Statute of Limitations Dispute

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the statute of limitations on your account, ACC-389688. We appreciate the opportunity to review the matter with you.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA) and Tennessee state law, we must verify the accuracy of the information on your account. We have reviewed the account records and confirm that the original creditor, Citylink Communications, charged off the account on 2022-09-27. The last payment date on file is 2023-05-08.

We will investigate your dispute and determine whether the statute of limitations has expired. We will provide you with a written response regarding our findings and any necessary actions.

Please note that you have the right to dispute this matter further if you disagree with our findings. You may also request verification of the debt, including the amount owed, if you have not already done so.

We will contact you in writing with the results of our investigation and any subsequent actions.

Sincerely,
